title: Constant-speed displacement interpolation for arbitrary P2 endpoints
source_anchor: Chewi, Niles-Weed and Rigollet, Statistical Optimal Transport, SHA256 639ff16e79f4a32ade9c0595b0ed1d95490eb7e402949168895b6a6194a9c02f, Theorem 7.6, printed pp.209-210/PDF pp.215-216; compared with Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, 2026-08-20 live PDF SHA256 8818e8fb40c07bd70651bafe10e8ec4500197c836928330b90025ca47da52fae, Theorem 1.3.23, printed p.30/PDF p.42
target_statement: For probability measures mu0 and mu1 on the existing finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, assume integrability of x mapped to norm x squared for each endpoint. Given a quadratic-optimal coupling gamma and 0 <= s <= t <= 1, prove that the Wasserstein distance between the affine pushforwards at s and t equals ofReal(t-s) times the endpoint Wasserstein distance. Retain the existing P2ac theorem under its current name as a corollary.
